items.d: Provides a fusion of relaxing hot mineral spring bathing, spa therapies and picturesque lake views. Voted a World Top Ten Spa by Conde Nast Traveller magazine at the 2004-2007, and 2009 Annual Spa Awards.
Yam is a ski resort in north of Tabriz in vicinity of Marand cirty and in northern foot hills of Mishoodaghi. It is accessible via Tabirz-Marand highway.

Among the 12 fountains there are: Geyser (Гейзер), Heroes of Fairy Tales (Герои сказок), Four Seasons (Четыре времени года), symbolized by bronze horses, the Curtain (Завеса), is just behind the former.
Awesome archeological museum with mummies, deformed skulls, amazing pottery and other artifacts. Well worth a visit.

This temple was built in 1571 by king Minphalaung on sand stone. The entrance is to the east and the temple is famous for its internal stone sculptures. It inhabits many displays of live at the royal court.
The island of Hengam is famous for watching dolphins. Tours from Qeshm start at the port of Shib Deraz.
The park service keeps sled dogs for use in the winter, and during the summer offers daily demonstrations for visitors. Demonstrations are at 10AM, 2PM, and 4PM and last for 30 minutes.

Also known as Naenggol, Cold Valley due to its cold weather around the year. Into the valley's walls several Buddha figures have been sculpted.

Races are held on a 10-km race track, and there are nearby camel stables which can also be visited. There is plenty of seating in the grandstand, although for the best view you can follow the race in your car along pavement which…
You can buy tickets from the ticket office around the side. There's a sauna, ice-cold pool, and for an extra 200 som an attendant will lather you up, scrub you and then hose you down.
Gorgeous scenery. Those physically fit can explore the countryside. Confusing to get to on a map, but locals are happy to give directions.

A giant sand dune across the river from Gao, named for its glowing pink color at sunrise and sunset. Best reached by pirogue. The top has beautiful views of the surrounding landscape, especially after the rainy season.
The memorial to Jagjivan Ram, the fourth Deputy Prime Minister of India.
A nature preservation area just a few hundred meters off the city centre. The 700-m-long trail goes along river Tourujoki.
Statue of the country's first president.
This mosque with a very beautiful and interesting architecture is included in the list of 30 most unique mosques in the world.
The Brazil House space is occasionally rented out to a church, and it is tough to find without a local guide. A family that lives there is helpful in explaining the space's history.

This was once a hilltop thermal feature that would hurl mud into the nearby trees during eruptions, but a particularly large eruption blew apart the Mud Volcano, leaving a hot, bubbling mud pool at the base of the hill.
It is a ruined temple, and is near the Chattarbhuj Temple.
Azerbaijan's highest mountain.

A cave system between Gavanovac lake and Kaluderovac lake. Stairs are carved out into the rocks, allowing visitors to ascend up to the canyon ridges, or descend down to the hiking trails along the waterfront.

items.d: The tunnel open for visitors has an entrance next to the Cathedral of St. Vitus and extends under Rijeka's Old Town to the courtyard of the Dolac Elementary School.
Housed in La Pagode, a structure that resembles a pagoda, showcases local artists' work and facilitates arts and culture in the community.
Textile Industry museum including machines and lives of workers. Guided tours are in French.
Eco-tours. They explicitly don't feed the sharks, they use reusable boxes for lunch and let you refill your bottle with water.

The church was built in 1910, in Neo-Byzantine, based on the plans of János Bobula. Unlike other Greek Orthodox churches there is no iconostasis here. The main sights are the inlaid altar and pulpit with mosaic ornaments in 1910.
It is also known as Gyeonggi English Village Ansan Camp.
Extensive collection of American Indian art and artifacts. It is a subsidiary of the Autry Museum and undergoing major renovations.
There is regular bus line that runs on 30-min intervals, buses are leaving from the bus stop at the New Post. The mineral springs are hot (41°C) and lightly mineralised (0.604 g/L).

The Osaka Tournament of Japan's national sport, sumo wrestling, is usually held mid-March annually at Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium. Check for schedules and ticket availabilities at the official Nihon Sumo Kyokai homepage.

At the old town limits next to Rhine. Here was the erstwhile castle of the Earls of Berg, the later duke of Jülich-Kleve-Berg. The castle was later reconstructed as a baroque palace, which burned down in 1872.
The biggest of several oases in the region, the oasis is made up of thousands of date palms. The oasis sits between the main souq area downtown and Al Ain street.
Changing contemporary art exhibitions, see website for schedule.
Hike along the paths of the park.

This visitor centre has useful information on the leisure activities offered in the Madriu-Perafita-Claror valley, as well as facts on the tasks carried out to manage the valley and promote the values that have made it a UNESCO…
Theme park with reconstructions of an Iron Age village, a Stone Age camp, a Viking market, a 19th-century farm, and cottages.
The museum is the house of birth of the writer Robert Musil. If you are interested in literature, this is the place to go.
It is the highest mountain of all Adriatic islands. It has a great view of the Zlatni Rat beach, place Bol and islands Hvar and Vis.

An easy 3 looping trail through an area that was logged in the 1880s. Today, the remaining white pines have matured, and the area is one of the best preserved old growth white pine forests in the park.
